additionalRules: If a Dwarf King is your General, they gain the Leader (Khazâd Guard) special rule.

specialRules.name: "The wealth of Moria lay not in gold or jewels, but in Mithril"
specialRules.text: Friendly models may re-roll To Wound Rolls of a natural 1 when making Strikes.

specialRules.name: Steadfast Warriors
specialRules.text: Friendly Dwarf Captains, Dwarf Warriors and Dwarf Rangers gain the Dominant (2) special rule.

specialRules.name: The Stubbornness of Dwarves
specialRules.text: During a Duel Roll, before any re-rolls have been used, if the opposition player has rolled more dice (including for Supporting models), then a single friendly Khazad-dûm model may re-roll a single D6 as part of the Duel Roll.

specialRules.name: Dwarven Mirrors
specialRules.text: At the start of the game, after both sides have deployed, you may deploy two 40mm Dwarven Mirror Markers anywhere on the battlefield that is not within the opposition deployment zone. The area within 6" of a Dwarven Mirror Marker is always considered to be daylight; enemy shooting attacks targeting a model within 6" suffer -1 To Hit, and Orc, Goblin, or Cave Dweller models suffer -1 to Courage Tests within 6". An enemy model in base contact during the End Phase that has only Moved that turn can remove the Marker from play.

specialRules.name: Exquisite Mithril Armour
specialRules.text: This is a set of Unique Mithril Armour that will add 4 to Durin's Defence rather than the usual 3 (already included in his profile).

specialRules.name: Durin's axe
specialRules.text: This is a Unique Master-forged two-handed weapon. Additionally, Durin may re-roll a single D6 when making a Duel Roll.

specialRules.name: The Horn of Zirakzigil
specialRules.text: This is a Unique war horn, which also gives Durin the Terror special rule.

specialRules.name: The Ring of Durin
specialRules.text: This is a Unique piece of wargear. Once per game during the Priority Phase, after the roll for Priority has taken place, the bearer of the Ring of Durin can re-roll their side's Priority Roll.

specialRules.name: The Crown of Kings
specialRules.text: This is a Unique piece of wargear. Whenever Durin suffers a Wound, roll a D6. On a natural 6, the Wound is prevented and is ignored.

specialRules.name: Dwarven Lords
specialRules.text: A Dwarf King will always have the Faction Keyword of the most common type of Dwarf model in the same Army, and gains a special rule based on it: Erebor - Ancient Enemies (Orc); Iron Hills - Fearless; Khazad-dûm - throwing weapons.

specialRules.name: Torozul
specialRules.text: This is a Unique Foe Spear with the Trollbane special rule. Additionally, Mardin gains an additional bonus of +1 To Wound when making Strikes against Monster models.

specialRules.name: Durin's Protector
specialRules.text: During the Declare Heroic Actions step of the Fight Phase, if Durin is Engaged in Combat and is within 6" of Mardin, then Mardin may declare a free Heroic Combat. If this Heroic Combat is successful, then Mardin must use the following Move to join Durin's Combat.

specialRules.name: Dominant (2)
specialRules.text: Granted by the Steadfast Warriors army special rule.

specialRules.name: In Defence of the King
specialRules.text: During the Declare Heroic Actions step of the Fight Phase, if a friendly Dwarf General is Engaged in Combat and is within 6" of this model, then this model may declare a free Heroic Combat. If this Heroic Combat is successful, then this model must use the following Move to join the friendly Dwarf General model's Combat.

specialRules.name: The Herald's Duty
specialRules.text: This model receives a bonus of +1 to its Defence for each other friendly model with this special rule it is in base contact with.

specialRules.name: Mountain Fighters
specialRules.text: This model gains a bonus of +1 To Wound when making Strikes against a model that is within a piece of difficult terrain, such as a piece of rocky terrain, or a ruin.

specialRules.name: Dominant (2)
specialRules.text: Granted by the Steadfast Warriors army special rule.

specialRules.name: Dominant (2)
specialRules.text: Granted by the Steadfast Warriors army special rule.

units.name: Vault Warden Team
wargear: Iron Shield Bearer (Heavy Armour, Hand Weapon, Iron Shield)
Foe Spear Wielder (Heavy Armour, Foe Spear; Mv5" Fv4 Sv4+ S4 D6 A1 W1 C6+ I6+)

specialRules.name: Iron Shield
specialRules.text: This is a shield that provides a bonus of +3 to a model's Defence rather than the usual +1. Additionally, a model carrying an Iron Shield suffers a -1 penalty to their Duel Rolls, unless they are Supported by a model with a Foe Spear.

specialRules.name: Foe Spear
specialRules.text: This is a spear. Additionally, if a model with a Foe Spear is Supporting a model with an Iron Shield, they gain a bonus of +1 To Wound when making Strikes against Monster models.

units.name: Dwarven Ballista
wargear: Crewed by two Dwarf Siege Crew (Mv5" Fv4 Sv4+ S4 D6 A1 W1 C6+ I6+, Armour, Hand Weapon), one of which is the Siege Veteran

specialRules.name: Accurate
specialRules.text: A Dwarven Ballista will only Scatter 3" rather than 6".

specialRules.name: Piercing Shot
specialRules.text: A model that is hit by the shot of a Dwarven Ballista will be flung back D6" directly away from the Dwarven Ballista if it has a Strength of 5 or lower, suffering hits and being knocked Prone.
